title: Step off a report's suggested reviewers
description: Take the authenticated user off this report's suggested reviewers, leaving the other reviewers in place. Use it when a report was routed to them by mistake, so it stops reaching them without closing it for anyone else. The report's own state does not change: it stays open for whoever is left, and for the project. Succeeds whether or not the user was on the list, so a repeat call is safe. To change who else reviews a report, edit its `suggested_reviewers` artefact instead.
